title: Concurrent electrode–electrolyte interfaces engineering via nano-Si3N4 additive for high-rate, high-voltage lithium metal batteries
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,3148-3159
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE03862B, Paper
Open Access

Jinuk Kim, Dong Gyu Lee, Ju Hyun Lee, Saehun Kim, Cheol-Young Park, Jiyoon Lee, Hyeokjin Kwon, Hannah Cho, Jungyoon Lee, Donghyeok Son, Hee-Tak Kim, Nam-Soon Choi, Tae Kyung Lee, Jinwoo Lee
The nano-Si3N4 additive enables the concurrent engineering of electrode–electrolyte interfaces. It promotes the formation of a bilayer, inorganic-rich SEI via its involvement in SEI formation and Li+ solvation, and a uniform CEI by scavenging HF.
